lang.help: Optional translation language (ISO code) to select when sending out an email. If not set, the main partner's language will be used. This should usually be a placeholder expression that provides the appropriate language, e.g. {{ object.partner_id.lang }}.
lang.name: lang

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.
activity_state.name: activity_state

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.
activity_exception_decoration.name: activity_exception_decoration

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.
activity_exception_icon.name: activity_exception_icon

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.name: message_needaction

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.name: message_has_error

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.name: message_has_error_counter

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.name: message_has_sms_error

preview.help:
Catchy preview sentence that encourages recipients to open this email.
In most inboxes, this is displayed next to the subject.
Keep it empty if you prefer the first characters of your email content to appear instead.
preview.name: preview

favorite_date.help: When this mailing was added in the favorites
favorite_date.name: favorite_date

calendar_date.help: Date at which the mailing was or will be sent.
calendar_date.name: calendar_date

body_html.name: body_html
body_html.string: Body converted to be sent by mail

reply_to_mode.help: Thread: replies go to target document. Email: replies are routed to a given email.
reply_to_mode.name: reply_to_mode

mail_server_available.help: Technical field used to know if the user has activated the outgoing mail server option in the settings
mail_server_available.name: mail_server_available

mail_server_id.help: Use a specific mail server in priority. Otherwise Odoo relies on the first outgoing mail server available (based on their sequencing) as it does for normal mails.
mail_server_id.name: mail_server_id

use_exclusion_list.help: Prevent sending messages to blacklisted contacts. Disable only when absolutely necessary.
use_exclusion_list.name: use_exclusion_list

ab_testing_enabled.help: If checked, recipients will be mailed only once for the whole campaign. This lets you send different mailings to randomly selected recipients and test the effectiveness of the mailings, without causing duplicate messages.
ab_testing_enabled.name: ab_testing_enabled

ab_testing_is_winner_mailing.name: ab_testing_is_winner_mailing
ab_testing_is_winner_mailing.string: Is the Winner of its Campaign

ab_testing_pc.help: Percentage of the contacts that will be mailed. Recipients will be chosen randomly.
ab_testing_pc.name: ab_testing_pc

ab_testing_schedule_datetime.help: Date that will be used to know when to determine and send the winner mailing
ab_testing_schedule_datetime.name: ab_testing_schedule_datetime

ab_testing_winner_selection.help: Selection to determine the winner mailing that will be sent.
ab_testing_winner_selection.name: ab_testing_winner_selection

warning_message.help: Warning message displayed in the mailing form view
warning_message.name: warning_message

automated_marketing.name: automated_marketing
automated_marketing.string: Specific mailing used in marketing campaign
